COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1453 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. M.S. Bhandari, learned counsel
for the petitioners.
2. Mr. S.S. Lingwal, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, 
learned counsel for the respondent 
Nos.1 to 4/University.
3. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned 
Additional C.S.C. for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent No.5.
4. The present writ petition has been 
filed by the petitioners seeking writ of 
mandamus directing the respondents to 
pay the amount of Gratuity to the 
petitioners under the provisions of 
‘Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972’ and as 
per the mandate of the Hon’ble Apex 
Court in the case of Netram Sahu Vs. 
State of Chhattisgarh’ reported in 2018 
5 SCC 430, after counting the entire 
length of services rendered by the 
petitioners as Daily Wagers in the 
respondent-University including 
statutory interest payable under the Act 
of 1972.
5. Vide previous order dated 
02.08.2024, instructions were called 
from respondent-University.
6. Today, learned counsel for the 
respondent-University passed on to  2
Court the Family Pension Payment 
Order dated 29.04.2024, wherefrom, it 
is reflected that a payment of 
Rs.1,58,508/- was made towards the 
Gratuity of petitioner-Nafees Khan from 
22.11.2013 to 31.03.2023.
7. According to learned counsel for the 
petitioner, petitioners are entitled for 
Gratuity from the date of their initial 
induction of service i.e. in the year 
1992.
8. In this view of the matter, 
respondents are directed to file counter 
affidavits within a period of four weeks.
9. Two weeks’ time, thereafter, is 
granted to petitioners to file rejoinder 
affidavit.
10. List on 04.10.2024.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.08.2024
PN
